name: Grove Stone Baptist Church
hours: Mon 8 AM–4 PM; Tue 8 AM–4 PM; Wed 8 AM–4 PM; Thu 8 AM–4 PM; Fri Closed; Sat Closed; Sun 9:30 AM–12:30 PM

reviews.t: I have to agree with Norris. I was there when he was there. Wonderful people!! Amazing food and great company. I will always remember my stay and all the wonderful people I met. And yes, Grady's cobblers were the best. It was comforting to know we had a warm, welcoming place to go after our day, seeing horrific destruction, and we were able to talk about it with other volunteers. Thank you so much for the wonderful hospitality and love. I left a piece of my heart there. Sue

Pastor Mike, Mr. and Mrs. David Dodge and each member I met, welcomed me as if I was an old friend. The fellowship was up lifting, motivating and Christ honoring. Grove Stone Baptist Church is a great church.
Great food; Great accommodations; Great company; Even Characters with Cobblers. Enjoyed staying very much. Thanks
They love the Lord and they will love you too. This is a church that preaches and teaches the word of God.
I'm a member there for nay on 30 yrs , great place to come worship , one big family
